metadata.name: Get Confident Peaks From ATAC or CUTandRUN replicates (release v1.0)
annotations: This workflow takes as input BAM from ATAC-seq or CUT&RUN. It calls peaks on each replicate and intersect them. In parallel, each BAM is subsetted to smallest number of reads. Peaks are called using all subsets combined. Only peaks called using a combination of all subsets which have summits intersecting the intersection of at least x replicates will be kept.
